notes.interpretation: The printed Amr ibn al-Harith ibn Mustaliq transmits an anonymous saying. The passive deyilar ediki (it used to be said) is integral and must remain. It describes two persons receiving severe punishment: a wife disobedient to her husband and an imam disliked by his people. The source supplies no Prophet attribution, ultimate speaker, Companion status or grade. A register decision can only be a transmitted anonymous saying through the printed Amr, retaining the full173-character first paragraph, with explicit unknown origin and authenticity.

fields.text: Амр ибн Ал-Ҳорис ибн Мустолиқдан ривоят қилинди; айтди: «Дейилар эдики, инсонлардан азоби қаттиқ бўладигани икки кишидир: эрига осий бўлган хотин ва қавми ёмон кўрган имом».

notes.interpretation: Jarir relays Mansur: when they asked about the imam, an unnamed answer explained that only transgressing imams are intended, while blame rests on people who dislike an imam carrying out the Sunna. This is a source-attested explanatory question/answer, explicitly dependent on the preceding imam wording. Preserve all214 characters as separately attributed source commentary and retain its qualifying relevance; do not attribute it to the Prophet or invent the anonymous respondent. It does not supply the origin of the primary anonymous saying.

fields.text: Жарир айтади: «Мансур дедики: «Имом борасида савол берганимизда бизга бундай дейилди: «Бу билан, фақат ҳаддан ошган имомлар кўзда тутилган. Суннатни бажо қиладиган имомга келсак, гуноҳ уни ёқтирмаган кишиларгадир».

heading_read: Қавм хоҳламаган кишининг қавмга имом бўлмоғи
